title: Qimbô rooci soolam
intro: der udduruuk naharal faxe farmoyti ardi bagul gexak naharal, faxe kutbeyta baxxaqimtaamak naharal, gersiimih inna sinni gino manol temeete. Tama rooci yallih gabat weeloyseeh, qeedaalisso sinni qaxmaqaaneh arac yeceeh, inkih tan seehadayti baxi aydaadul qagaaqagitak gibbatu abe. maca katayteh sugtem qaku le aydaadu, baguuk toobittem kee sarrimaaneh ginok korsi milaagele umman way. Atu ah miyya kinnim fayramissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu kaxxa Racmatta le gabat weeloseh suge ardi qaanak
Anu qeedaalisso sinni qaxmaqaane le buxa yomcowweeh, qululuu kee ecla yoo xage wayta
Anu inki caxa fan xayyoowe wayuh amriseh suge, toh waaso luk sugte
Yoo kee Yi wakliiti duquurusneeh, waasen caxah xayyoosenno, ni Rabbih amrik saduh.
Nanu nuduurem ninni Rabbih fan baguuk toobit kee ninni qellat cabsu
nek, inkih tan seehadayti baxi obte; Anu tama ardi bagul qemmol gexe num kinniyo

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Sehdayti baxi qemmoh hanaawise akkuk ardi bagul ruube
Firqawni kee kay qande baddi addat culte.
outcome.answer: Sehdayti baxi qemmoh hanaawise akkuk ardi bagul ruube

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
